description: Human difficulty scores (1=trivial, 10=hardest to understand/modify safely), assigned by reading the code before the metric was computed. The check compares the RANKING, not the absolute scores.

f03_long_straight.note: 41 lines but zero branches; tedious, not difficult. Line-count metrics misjudge this one.

f08_short_circuit.note: and/or precedence must be mentally simulated

f05_if_elif_chain.note: flat dispatch chain, easy to extend

f14_comprehension_heavy.note: nested comprehension, two filters on one clause

f09_try_except.note: three exception paths plus in-try branch

f10_nested_ifs.note: four nesting levels, must track context stack

f12_match_dispatch.note: six structural patterns with capture bindings
